facts.text: I find it frustrating that big corporations prioritize profit over the well-being of consumers and the environment.
I question whether big corporations have a conscience.
I find it frustrating that corporations only care about their profits, especially when it comes at the cost of the environment and our health.
I feel like money is more important than anything else to corporations.
I find it frustrating that corporations always seem to find loopholes and ways to get out of taking responsibility for their actions.
I believe corporations should be held accountable for the damage they cause to the environment and people's health.
I believe it shouldn't be all about the bottom line.
I find it ridiculous that corporations value profits over people's lives.
I feel like corporations have no empathy or compassion for anyone or anything besides their own bank accounts.
I wish more people would boycott these companies and force them to change their ways.
I find it frustrating that some people still prioritize convenience over sustainability.
I believe some people choose the quick and easy option regardless of the impact it has on the environment.
I feel like some people don't care about what we leave behind for future generations.
